score: XGB probability from selected boosting range; sigmoid of neural logit
threshold_rule: If n sorted gluon scores and k=floor(0.1*n), take zero-based index n-k-1. Accept only score > threshold, so ties are conservative. Freeze each model/seed threshold before either final score array is computed.
contrasts: PFN-K minus XGB on each cohort
PFN-ID minus PFN-K on each cohort
PID contrast on source minus PID contrast on target
matched_input_control: Report XGB and MLP using identical aggregate features; no final model selection.
aggregation: Per-seed metrics; arithmetic mean and range across three seeds, never a prediction ensemble.

bootstrap.rng: numpy PCG64, independent child stream per cohort
bootstrap.sampling: Resample rows within each class and cohort, sharing indices across models and seeds. Compute contrasts of seed-mean metrics; source and target draws are independent for the transfer interaction.
bootstrap.interval: Descriptive 2.5% and 97.5% percentiles; fixed trained models and fixed calibrated cuts. Excludes retraining and threshold-estimation uncertainty; no simultaneous-significance claim.
